messages:
auditor_mik: Hi team — for SOC2 sampling we need an evidence bundle for the minor RBAC change and cache-key rotation during the 2025-03-11 window. Items: approver trail, PR diff, infra apply log, k8s audit showing RoleBinding edit, CloudTrail KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt tied to deploy_id, and key rotation policy snapshot.

sarah_sre: assigning. I can export kube audit (inference-prod), CloudTrail KMS slice, and CI/terraform logs. Prefer jsonl and a README mapping to CC6/CC7.

owen_sec: context: change added serviceAccount `inference-cache-proxy` to RoleBinding `inference-deploy` as part of a minor patch. PR: #4912 (sha: 9f7e2a). Terraform run_id: tf-apply-20250311-04; deploy_id=20250311-04. We also performed a manual rewrap of alias/redwood-cache-key at 2025-03-11T07:22Z.

kai_ops: I approved the PR in Okta (okta_evt=evt-20250311-22). I will export the Okta audit event and PR merge webhook.

sarah_sre: sample sanitized k8s audit I'll include: {"stageTimestamp":"2025-03-11T07:20:10Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"kai_ops","uid":"U-1102"},"objectRef":{"resource":"rolebindings","name":"inference-deploy"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-cache-proxy}]"}}

owen_sec: sample CloudTrail KMS event (sanitized): {"eventTime":"2025-03-11T07:21:45Z","eventName":"GenerateDataKey","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/worker"},"resources":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/9900-aaaa-bbbb"],"requestParameters":{"encryptionContext":{"deploy_id":"20250311-04","pr_sha":"9f7e2a"}}}

evidence-bot: terraform run completed: tf-apply-20250311-04; status: success; changes:+1 serviceaccount; artifact: sha256:1a2b3c...

sarah_sre: plan: assemble bundle with README.md (file->SOC2 mapping), timeline.txt (PR#4912 -> tf-apply -> kube patch -> KMS), k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-kms.jsonl, terraform-apply.log, okta-event.jsonl, pr-diff.patch, keypolicy.pdf, checksums.sha256. Will redact ciphertext blobs and annotate redactions in README.

auditor_mik: please include sha256 hashes and a one-line signed approval from the approver for ISO mapping. Also highlight a single correlation line in the timeline that ties PR->deploy_id->kms event.

kai_ops: will add a short signed note. Uploading bundle to s3://redwood-audit/quick-samples/2025-03-11/1809990000_bundle.zip and DM presigned link when done.

sarah_sre: uploaded. checksums.sha256 included. DM sent with presigned link. tagging this thread as resolved pending auditor review.

auditor_mik: received. we'll review and follow up if raw traces are needed. thanks for the quick turnaround.
